error_saving_text: The change could not be saved (disk full or folder unavailable). Nothing is lost: try again.
plot_absent: No plot yet: draw yours to get started.
plan_scope: applies to {year} and the following seasons
plan_no_free_space: No free space left on the plot for a new bed.
plan_empty: No bed this season. Click the plan, or drag an item from the tray.
timeline_empty: No planting yet. Add a bed in the editor, then plant it.
export_help: A file to keep, or to move to another device.
import_help: Replaces the current garden after confirmation.
import_summary: This file is dated {date}. It holds {beds} beds and {plantings} plantings.
import_local_newer: The garden on this device was changed more recently, on {date}.
import_replaces_all: It will replace all current data.
erase_help: Deletes the whole garden from this device, after a double confirmation.
erase_confirm_1_text: The plot, beds, plantings and notes of this device will be deleted.
erase_confirm_2_text: This is final. Export the garden first if you want to keep it.
settings_clear_help: Removes all beds from the current season and the following ones.
settings_clear_text: Beds removed: {beds}. Plantings deleted: {plantings}. Notes of these beds from {year} are removed too.
settings_clear_kept: The plot, past seasons and notes of the whole garden are kept.
settings_clear_nothing: No bed to remove this season.
settings_clear_past: A past season cannot be cleared.
import_incoherences_title: Issues to resolve after the import: {count}
import_incoherences_text: Nothing is deleted or fixed: the file is imported as it is, and you resolve each issue afterwards with the usual actions.
import_i_planting_orphan: The planting of {crop} no longer has its bed "{bed}" in {year}.
import_i_planting_orphan_unknown: The planting of {crop} belongs to an unknown bed.
import_i_overlap: On "{bed}", {crop} and {other} take the same segments on the same dates.
import_i_zone_outside_bed: The planting of {crop} goes beyond "{bed}" in {year} ({count} segments).
import_i_crop_unknown: The crop "{crop}" is not in the catalogue.
import_i_aisle_too_narrow: "{bed}" and "{other}" are closer than the aisle width in {year}.
import_i_width_invalid: A bed is less than 10 cm wide.
import_i_note_bed_unknown: A note belongs to an unknown bed.
import_i_note_invalid: A note has a text or dates that are not valid.
import_i_other: Another inconsistency was found in the file.
state_import_unreadable: This file is unreadable or is not a Potagerie export. The garden on this device has not changed.
state_import_too_recent: This file has an unknown format: it comes from a newer version of Potagerie. Update the app to open it. The garden on this device has not changed.
state_file_text: The file could not be read or written (folder unavailable, disk full, file open elsewhere). The garden on this device has not changed.
note_error_text: The text of a note is 1 to 80 characters long.
note_error_dates: A period ends on the same day as it starts, or after.
error_year_past: Past seasons can no longer be changed.
error_crop_unknown: This crop is not in the catalogue.
error_zone_invalid: The chosen zone is not valid.
error_bed_absent: This bed does not exist on this date.
error_zone_outside_bed: The zone goes beyond the bed.
error_conflict: Another planting already takes these segments on these dates.
error_pot_days_required: Enter at least one day in pots.
error_out_of_range: A value is out of range: years from 1900 to 2200, durations up to 3,650 days.
error_manual_end_invalid: The end must come after the start of the harvest.
error_occupation_empty: The planting does not take any day.
error_length_invalid: The length must be a whole number of cells.
error_cell_invalid: The cell size must be 25, 50 or 100 cm.
error_saving: The data could not be read or saved.
error_version_stale: The garden changed in the meantime. Reload the season and try again.
error_base_too_recent: This data comes from a newer version of Potagerie.
error_base_unreadable: The data file is damaged and cannot be read.
load_failed_text: The data file of this app could not be read. Try again; if it keeps failing, open the settings and erase the app data to start again. Export the garden first if you have a recent file.
error_file: The file could not be read or written.
error_import_invalid: This file is not a Potagerie export.
error_import_too_recent: This file comes from a newer version of Potagerie.
error_svg_invalid: The timeline image could not be read.
error_rendering_impossible: The timeline image could not be created.
plot_intro: The whole rectangular area that you will then cut into beds in the editor.
plot_case_lock: The cell size sets the size of the beds' segments: it cannot be changed once the plot is created.
plot_aisle_help: Kept between the beds in the editor. Can be changed at any time in the settings.
plot_preview_empty: The plot is still empty: you will drag the first beds onto it in the plan editor.
plot_dimensions_invalid: Each side must be between 1 and 100 m, and at least one cell.
plan_help_drag_text: to move it (long press on a phone)
tray_title: Drag a bed onto the plot
tray_click: Click the plan to put a bed there, or tap an item to put it in the first free spot.
field_length_help: The length moves cell by cell ({case} cm). The width is set to the centimetre.
panel_follow: The crops and notes of the bed follow it when it is moved.
panel_read_only: Past season: the bed can be viewed, not changed.
delete_bed_text: If you continue, the bed will be removed from the plan from {year}.
delete_bed_plantings: Plantings deleted: {count}. They touch {year} or a later season, including those straddling the year.
delete_bed_kept: Plantings already finished on 1 January {year} are kept.
shorten_text: Plantings that will no longer fit in the bed: {count}. They will be flagged as conflicts until you move them.
error_plot_invalid: The plot dimensions are not valid: 1 to 100 m per side.
error_aisle_invalid: The aisle width must be 30, 50 or 80 cm.
error_width_invalid: A bed must be at least 10 cm wide.
error_name_invalid: The name of a bed is 1 to 30 characters long.
error_bed_outside_plot: Position refused. The bed would leave the plot. It goes back to its place.
error_bed_overlaps: Position refused. The bed would overlap another bed. It goes back to its place.
error_aisle_too_narrow: Position refused. The aisle width must be kept between two beds. It goes back to its place.
timeline_help: Drag the timeline to go from one year to the next, without a break.
timeline_aria: Crop timeline: one row per bed, months in columns
timeline_slot_aria: Free slot on {bed}, {days} days, from {start} to {end}. Opens the planting creation.
timeline_empty_beds: No bed on this date. Add a bed in the editor, then plant it.
timeline_refusal: Move refused. {reason} The planting goes back to its place.
timeline_help_bar: Click a bar to edit it, drag it to shift it (long press on a phone). Click a dotted slot to plant.
planting_mode_indoor_help: In pots, then transplanted to the garden
planting_mode_plants_help: Ready to plant, from a garden centre
planting_mode_ground: I sow in the open ground
planting_link_transplanting: I rather know the transplanting date
planting_link_sowing: I rather know the sowing date
planting_pots_help: This crop has no pot phase in the catalogue: enter the duration, at least 1 day.
planting_delete_text: {crop} on {bed}, from {start} to {end}. The deletion is final.
planting_problem_conflict: Conflict with {crop} on segments {start}–{end}, from {from} to {to}.
planting_problem_zone: The zone goes beyond the bed: it has {segments} segments in {year}.
planting_problem_absent: The bed does not exist in {year}.
catalogue_count: {count} crops. Perennials (asparagus, rhubarb…) are not included.
diorama_aria: Isometric view of the garden on {date}: {beds} beds, {plantings} plantings in the ground
diorama_bed_aria: {name}, {type}. Plantings in the ground: {count}. Open the details.
diorama_invite: Tap or click a bed to see its details. Drag the cursor, or play the season, to watch the plants grow.
diorama_empty: No bed to show. Add some in the plan editor.
diorama_playback_reduced: Reduced motion: the season moves week by week, without transitions.
export_format_png_help: To share or keep a record
export_period_help: By default, the period shown on screen.
export_period_empty: Choose a start date and an end date.
export_period_reversed: The end must be the same day as the start, or after.
export_pdf_help: The PDF and the image reproduce the timeline as it is drawn here.
resolve_help: Nothing was deleted or fixed. Resolve each issue with the usual actions: this list updates by itself.
